actionable_items.issue: Replace the universal claim with a local-dataset claim.
actionable_items.description: The packet overgeneralizes from a six-row local benchmark to all hospitals worldwide.

actionable_items.issue: Add out-of-sample validation before making deployment claims.
actionable_items.description: No external or multi-site evidence supports the worldwide deployment statement.

findings.evidence: The packet claims worldwide deployment, but the only measured result is a six-row local sample.
findings.suggestion: Restrict the claim to the evaluated local dataset or add broader out-of-sample validation.

findings.evidence: The packet assumes future datasets behave like the local benchmark without providing supporting evidence.
findings.suggestion: State the assumption explicitly and mark it unsupported until external evidence exists.

limitations: Deterministic local review evidence used to avoid live-provider dependence.
